# terrakube_policy_set_parameter (Data Source)

Query an OPA Policy Set Parameter in Terrakube by policy set ID and key (or ID).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_policy_set" "guardrails" {
  organization = "my-organization"
  name         = "blast-radius-guardrails"
}

data "terrakube_policy_set_parameter" "max_changes" {
  policy_set_id = data.terrakube_policy_set.guardrails.id
  key           = "max_resource_changes"
}

output "max_resource_changes" {
  value = data.terrakube_policy_set_parameter.max_changes.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_set_id` (String) Target Policy Set ID

### Optional

- `id` (String) Parameter ID (UUID). Specify either id or key.
- `key` (String) Parameter key identifier

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Parameter description
- `value` (String) Parameter value
